text:
Priya Rao: Heads-up: the scorecard dashboard for model x-7 is showing a ~12% drop in exact_match after this morning's quantized bring-up. Also seeing duplicate spikes in the time-series. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/shot123 :eyes:
Ben Chu: I noticed that too. looks like two eval runs with the same run_id were ingested. probable retried/run-dup during runner restart.
Carlos Mendez: CI said green though. ci-bot posted: 'eval-runner completed: 2 tests, 0 failures' — but prometheus shows metrics_count=2 for the same commit/hash.
Priya Rao: here's the relevant snippet from the logs we pulled:
```
2026-03-20T08:12:45Z runner INFO run_id=abcd1234 status=finished shards=1
2026-03-20T08:12:46Z runner INFO run_id=abcd1234 status=finished shards=1
```
Priya Rao: the aggregator is currently deduping by (model, commit) only, so two runs with same commit collapse but then get aggregated twice in some UI queries -> spikes. Needs run_id in the aggregation key.
Anya Lee: I can put a patch in the eval-aggregator to include run_id in the key. tiny change:
```
- key = (model, commit)
+ key = (model, commit, run_id)
```
Anya Lee: I'll add a unit test for duplicate run ingestion and a DB migration to backfill a run_id column.
Ben Chu: also the console diff view currently counts examples instead of unique run counts when showing per-run deltas — that's why the same examples show up twice. small UI fix too.
Carlos Mendez: I'll add a CI gate in the eval-runner job that fails when duplicate run_ids are detected for the same commit. proposed check:
```
if total_runs_for_commit != distinct_run_id_count:
    fail_pipeline("duplicate-run-ids detected")
```
Priya Rao: Plan: Anya deploys aggregator patch to staging behind a feature flag, run the quantize bring-up again (use commit abcd1234), verify dashboard and scorecard numbers, then promote. Carlos wires the CI check in parallel. If staging looks good, flip flag in prod during low-traffic window.
Anya Lee: working on a PR now. will link once ready. target: small migration + feature-flagged rollout.
Carlos Mendez: I'll open a small PR for the CI job and add a job-level alert to paging if duplicates slip through.
eval-bot: New aggregated report: https://console.redwood/evals/aggregates?run=abcd1234 :white_check_mark:
Priya Rao: Thanks — assigning to @Anya and @Carlos. I'll update the scorecard docs and create a follow-up for the UI diff fix. :thumbsup:
Ben Chu: nice catch. let me know if you want me to help with the staging rollout.
Anya Lee: will do. PR -> review -> canary deploy.
Carlos Mendez: ETA for CI PR: today EOD.
Priya Rao: OK closing the loop here. I'll post a short postmortem if anything unexpected pops in the staging run. :memo:
